metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for Writ. The repository root is the plugin, so `source` is './'.

plugins.name: writ
plugins.description: Guardrails for Claude Code: the rules that fit the task delivered per prompt, and no risky writes before you approve a plan and tests. Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector + graph traversal + weighted ranking, with an abstention gate) over a Neo4j knowledge graph, wired in through hook scripts and a session state machine.
